w2:textbox.label: Show Submission Status Window within the Tab (Custom)

(First TabControl)
1-1. Click the internal Submit button.
1-2. Confirm that the file specified as the processMsgFrameURL in the client.config.xml settings file is displayed only within the WFrame tab. (processMsgFrame=“true”)

(Second TabControl)
2-1. Click the Submit button inside.
2-2. Confirm that the file specified by the processMsgFrameURL entry in the client.config.xml configuration file is displayed on the entire screen. (processMsgFrame=“false”)
